infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CoParent Hub attaches your location to an exchange check-in only when you tap "Attach my location", so the record shows where the hand-off happened.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CoParent Hub uses the camera only when you choose to photograph a receipt or a document to attach to an expense or note.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CoParent Hub opens your photo library only when you choose a receipt or document photo to attach to an expense or note.
